name: chip
title: Chip
description: A chip's look, once for every chip: a file, an image, a link, a quote or a mention in a line of text, 24px tall, its icon or thumbnail first, then its name and a grey detail, on a hairline; muted on a field (the composer's; in dark, the page's colour, recessed in it), raised on a tint (a sent message's bubble), outline on the page (12px, grey, e.g. an answer's sources) and 26px (md) in a row of its own. Chip is a span of it, chipVariants the classes for a button or link, ChipList a wrapping row of them.
